rule: At a canonical decision boundary, a weekly member proven non-trading remains in the frozen roster but is not executable and is never replaced. A position held into the first unavailable boundary is force-settled at the preceding verified transaction bar close with the ordinary per-side cost multiplier and no participation cap; the strategy cannot reopen it while unavailable.
